claim: Metal-organic frameworks were the subject of the 2025 Nobel Chemistry Prize announced in Stockholm, Sweden.

sources.shows: The Royal Swedish Academy’s 2025 press release identifies metal-organic frameworks as the prize topic.

claim: John Jumper appeared among the 2025 Nobel Chemistry laureates announced in Stockholm, Sweden.

sources.shows: The Royal Swedish Academy names Kitagawa, Robson and Yaghi as the 2025 chemistry laureates; Jumper is absent.

claim: Three laureates shared each of the 2025 Nobel science prizes announced in Stockholm, Sweden.

sources.shows: The U.S. House Science Committee lists three laureates in each of the 2025 physics, chemistry and medicine prizes.

claim: Online viewers submitted precisely 3,117 questions to the 2025 Nobel Chemistry lecture in Stockholm, Sweden.
note: No reliable public record found for the stated exact count; absence of a published count is not evidence that the number is false.

claim: The 2022 HTTP status code for a disallowed known method is higher than the code for an unimplemented method worldwide.

sources.shows: MDN gives 501 for an unsupported method and says general-purpose servers must support GET and HEAD.
MDN gives 405 for a recognized method disallowed on the target.

claim: The Louisiana Purchase treaty signed in Paris, France, on April 30, 1803, priced the territory at $10 million.

sources.shows: The Archives gives the April 1803 France treaty, $15 million price and $10 million earlier authorization.

claim: The 2012 U.S. Statistical Abstract lists Louisiana’s Driskill Mountain at 535 feet and its low point 8 feet above sea level.
what_is_correct: Driskill Mountain is listed at 535 feet and the Louisiana low point at 8 feet relative to sea level.
what_needs_correction: The low point is 8 feet below, not above, sea level.
corrected_claim: The 2012 U.S. Statistical Abstract lists Louisiana’s Driskill Mountain at 535 feet and its low point 8 feet below sea level.

sources.shows: The 2012 U.S. Statistical Abstract gives Louisiana’s Driskill Mountain 535 feet and New Orleans 8 feet below sea level.

claim: By October 2025, WHO’s global malaria-free certification list covered 47 countries and one territory.

sources.shows: WHO reports 47 countries and one territory certified malaria-free by July 2025.
